about.title: About
about.text: I'm a Full Stack Developer and AI Automation Engineer based in Costa Rica, trained through Forward Costa Rica's Full Stack Web Development and AI Solutions for Business programs. I work at the intersection of product and infrastructure — I can build the UI, design the API, automate the workflow, and self-host the stack. Currently building AutoTaskAI, a B2B automation consultancy for health and dental clinics. Open to remote roles in full-stack development, AI integration, or automation engineering.
